_note: Starting values for tuning. Durations are in milliseconds and must be multiples of 50 (one tick). Percentages are basis points: 10000 = 100%.

grid._note: The placement board: flat-topped hexes in columns; each side has zone_rows rows and the rows between belong to no one (docs/plans/rebuild-phase1-arena-sim.md, section 1).

_plane_note: On the plane 1 hex = 1000 units. Units and rocks are circles; nav_cell is the hidden pathfinding grid's cell size. A unit with range 1 is melee: it reaches melee_reach (center to center); range 2 and up reach that many hexes. Units are 0.2 hex wide and melee reaches half a hex, so six can crowd one unit (playtest gate 1, decided 2026-09-28).
_engage_note: Engage: an enemy whose center is within engage_reach of an engager is next to it; one trying to reach someone else must spend break_free_ms breaking free before it can move.
_displacement_note: A push stopped early by a unit, a rock, or the arena's edge stuns the pushed unit (and a unit it hits) for collision_stun_ms. A leap's landing takes leap_land_ms unless the effect gives its own land_ms; the leaper can't act meanwhile.
_wound_note: Wounds (docs/plans/rebuild-between-fights.md, section 5): a hero who falls takes one, each wound_bp of max HP off, up to max_wounds.
_collapse_note: Rift Collapse: the outer ring crumbles at collapse_start_ms, then one ring inward every collapse_ring_ms (the middle ring never does); each is warned collapse_warning_ms before. Crumbled ground is walkable (phase 5c); anyone whose center is on it takes flat damage every second (collapse_by_act); the growth speeds up collapse_surge_ms - collapse_start_ms after the first ring crumbles.

collapse_by_act._note: Damage per second starts at base (Act 1: 15, phase 5c Decision 8) and grows by growth each second; from collapse_surge_ms the growth itself rises by accel each second. Act 3 is not decided yet.
